_policy: A source is on only when it publishes a feed meant for reuse (RSS) and robots.txt allows it. Sources that read web pages or internal APIs, or whose terms forbid reuse, are off ('off' says why); JOBDESK_ENABLE_SOURCES turns one on for a copy that has the site's permission.
_comment: Job sources. 'fields' is a list of field ids, or "all". 'kind' decides how ads are filtered: field_board = everything it lists belongs to its fields; broad_portal = whole public-sector portals, so the ad text must contain a field's core words (or the title a field word); employer/general = title, description or location must contain a field word. Before adding a source: check robots.txt and the site's terms, and record them here. Robots.txt is also checked automatically before every request (core/robots.py).

not_added.name: Työmarkkinatori (search API, the recommended replacement)
not_added.why: Not connected yet: needs credentials. Terms (updated 12.3.2026, read 2026-11-24): any organisation may use the search API; access is tied to a Y-tunnus and KEHA-keskus checks suitability; the user 'on oikeus esittää hakurajapinnan kautta saamiaan työpaikkailmoituksia omissa palveluissaan', must credit '(Lähde: Työmarkkinatorin asiakastietojärjestelmä)', keep ads current and remove deleted ones at once, and may not pass ads on to third parties or use them for marketing without permission. Covers all fields and every TE-office ad, including traineeships. Apply with the käyttöönottoilmoitus form; questions to tmt-rajapinnat@keha-keskus.fi. Test credentials first, then production. The old APIs close in May 2027.
